es.summary: Benzodiacepina de acción prolongada usada para ansiedad, insomnio y espasmos musculares; se elimina mayormente por metabolismo hepático.
key_points: Metabolismo hepático por CYP2C19 y CYP3A4; vida media prolongada en insuficiencia hepática.
Puede acumularse con inhibidores enzimáticos (p. ej., cimetidina).
Efectos adversos: somnolencia, depresión respiratoria, hipotensión.
Contraindicado en cirrosis grave y en pacientes con insuficiencia hepática severa.

mechanism: Potencia la acción del GABA al unirse al sitio modulador del receptor GABA‑A.
Aumenta la frecuencia de apertura del canal de cloro, hiperpolarizando la neurona.
indications: Ansiedad y trastorno de ansiedad generalizada.
Insomnio cuando se requiere ayuda farmacológica.
contraindications: Insuficiencia hepática grave o cirrosis descompensada.
Uso concomitante con depresores respiratorios sin supervisión.
interactions: Inhibidores de CYP450 (cimetidina, eritromicina) aumentan niveles.
Alcohol y opioides potencian depresión del SNC.
nursing_care: Evaluar pruebas de función hepática (AST, ALT, bilirrubina) antes de iniciar.
Monitorear nivel de conciencia, escala de Glasgow y frecuencia respiratoria cada 2‑4 h.
Retener la dosis si RR < 12 rpm o si el paciente muestra somnolencia excesiva.
Notificar al médico si aparecen signos de depresión respiratoria o hipotensión.
patient_teaching: Evitar alcohol y otros depresores del SNC mientras use diazepam.
No conducir ni operar maquinaria hasta saber cómo le afecta el medicamento.
Informar cualquier aumento de somnolencia, dificultad para respirar o visión borrosa.
antidote_overdose: Flumazenil IV 0.2 mg, repetir cada 1‑2 min hasta 1 mg máximo, monitorizar respuesta.
Soporte respiratorio y vigilancia continua de signos vitales.

outcomes: Paciente sin signos de sobredosis de diazepam al alta.
Pruebas de función hepática dentro de rangos normales durante la hospitalización.

interventions.action: Obtener y registrar pruebas de función hepática antes de iniciar el tratamiento.
interventions.rationale: Identifica alteraciones que aumentan el riesgo de acumulación del fármaco.

interventions.action: Monitorear nivel de conciencia y frecuencia respiratoria cada 2 h.
interventions.rationale: Detecta precozmente depresión respiratoria o sedación excesiva.

interventions.action: Revisar lista de medicamentos para identificar inhibidores de CYP450.
interventions.rationale: Previene interacciones que pueden elevar los niveles plasmáticos.

interventions.action: Educar al paciente sobre evitar alcohol y reportar somnolencia intensa.
interventions.rationale: Reduce factores que potencian la toxicidad del fármaco.

interventions.action: Retener la dosis y notificar al médico si RR < 12 rpm o si el paciente está demasiado somnoliento.
interventions.rationale: Previene progresión a depresión respiratoria grave.

en.summary: Long‑acting benzodiazepine used for anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms; primarily eliminated by hepatic metabolism.
key_points: Hepatic metabolism via CYP2C19 and CYP3A4; prolonged half‑life in hepatic impairment.
May accumulate with enzyme inhibitors (e.g., cimetidine).
Adverse effects: drowsiness, respiratory depression, hypotension.
Contraindicated in severe cirrhosis and advanced hepatic failure.

mechanism: Enhances GABA activity by binding to the modulatory site of the GABA‑A receptor.
Increases chloride channel opening frequency, hyperpolarizing the neuron.
indications: Insomnia when pharmacologic assistance is needed.
contraindications: Severe hepatic insufficiency or decompensated cirrhosis.
Concurrent use with respiratory depressants without supervision.
interactions: Alcohol and opioids potentiate CNS depression.
nursing_care: Assess liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin) before initiation.
Monitor level of consciousness, Glasgow scale, and respiratory rate every 2‑4 h.
Hold dose if RR < 12 rpm or if patient shows excessive drowsiness.
Notify physician if signs of respiratory depression or hypotension appear.
patient_teaching: Avoid alcohol and other CNS depressants while taking diazepam.
Do not drive or operate machinery until you know how the medication affects you.
Report any increase in drowsiness, breathing difficulty, or blurred vision.
antidote_overdose: Flumazenil IV 0.2 mg, repeat every 1‑2 min up to 1 mg total, monitor response.
Provide respiratory support and continuous vital sign monitoring.

outcomes: Patient without signs of diazepam overdose at discharge.
Liver function tests within normal limits during hospitalization.

interventions.action: Obtain and record liver function tests before starting therapy.
interventions.rationale: Identifies alterations that increase drug accumulation risk.

interventions.action: Monitor level of consciousness and respiratory rate every 2 h.
interventions.rationale: Detects early respiratory depression or excessive sedation.

interventions.action: Review medication list to identify CYP450 inhibitors.
interventions.rationale: Prevents interactions that may raise plasma levels.

interventions.action: Educate patient to avoid alcohol and report intense drowsiness.
interventions.rationale: Reduces factors that potentiate drug toxicity.

interventions.action: Hold dose and notify physician if RR < 12 rpm or patient is overly drowsy.
interventions.rationale: Prevents progression to severe respiratory depression.

key_points.1.quote: Cimetidine is a hepatic enzyme inhibitor. If the dose of the sedative-hypnotic is not decreased, it will accumulate and become toxic.

sections.indications.0.quote: Generalized anxiety disorder (GAD), panic disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), social anxiety disorder, and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) are examples of anxiety disorders.

sections.indications.1.quote: Insomnia is the inability to obtain an adequate amount of sleep needed to function efficiently during the day.

sections.indications.2.quote: In addition to anxiety, these medications can be used for alcohol withdrawal, agitation, and seizure disorders.

sections.contraindications.0.quote: Severe hepatic insufficiency is a contraindication.

sections.contraindications.2.quote: Concurrently taking another CNS depressant or drinking alcohol with this medication can intensify CNS depression and cause excessive drowsiness along with respiratory depression.

sections.adverse_effects.2.quote: Assess for signs/symptoms of dependence, overdose, and withdrawal, such as psychomotor agitation, insomnia, headache, tremor, palpitations, psychosis, and seizures.

sections.interactions.2.quote: Concurrently taking another CNS depressant or drinking alcohol with this medication can intensify CNS depression and cause excessive drowsiness along with respiratory depression.
